mission: Measure from the zero point how the full JUXTAPOSE + M2R-PM + JGPT teacher + Pivot-Slime student + TOPA Detective Spider + Keymaster + Exact JANUS loop improves, where gains occur, how much work is saved, what training costs, and when marginal learning slows, plateaus or regresses.

effective_resource_accounting.exact_check_capacity_multiplier: baseline exact checks / learned-system exact checks
effective_resource_accounting.pair_work_capacity_multiplier: baseline pair work / learned-system pair work
effective_resource_accounting.wall_clock_speedup_diagnostic: baseline wall time / current wall time on comparable hardware
effective_resource_accounting.interpretation: Learning can increase equivalent search capacity by reducing work per equally-correct result; it does not physically create CPU, RAM or energy.

plateau_watch.meaning: Plateau is a diagnostic signal to diversify data, add adversarial near-cap cases, inspect teacher-student bottlenecks and ask TOPA Detective Spider for unexplained relations/counterexamples; it is never a complexity lower-bound claim.

initial_zero_point.reason: No matched formula-fingerprint holdout baseline/current comparison has yet established a downstream speedup after accounting for training cost.

feedback_loop: Every exact run/checkpoint appends a KLGJ event.
KLGJ compares only against valid comparable baselines.
KLGJ records gain/regression by formula, scale, pivot context, configuration and module ablation.
KLGJ subtracts additional training/calibration cost from downstream savings.
KLGJ updates effective-capacity and learning-curve views.
Unexplained boosts, regressions and plateau signals are queued to TOPA_DETECTIVE_SPIDER for investigation.
TOPA/SPIDER findings return as hypotheses, never as proof.
Exact JANUS replay remains sole proof-state authority.
